exit 0
--- stdout
check: SERVING NOT_SERVING err rpc error: code = NotFound desc = unknown service
list: ""=SERVING(1) "a.A"=NOT_SERVING(2)
watch b.B: ["SERVICE_UNKNOWN", "SERVING", "NOT_SERVING"]
shutdown: NOT_SERVING NOT_SERVING err rpc error: code = NotFound desc = unknown service
resume: SERVING SERVING SERVING 3 7
done
